change_control: Any modification after any V2.1.1 experimental result is viewed requires a new version; v1, unexecuted v2, setup-failed v2.1, v2.1.1, and later versions remain distinguishable.

dataset.name: HEIG-Phish author processed data.pt
dataset.scope: the same labeled nodes as v1; this is stability evidence, not external or temporal generalization

h2_cross_model_confirmatory.comparator_rationale: Meta-IFD baseline is the model proposed by the paper; Meta-IFD+ is a group-created extension and is not the primary H2 comparator
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.cross_session_caveat: the three models run in separate sessions; the aggregator must verify identical test-node sets and labels for every split before pairing, while neighborhood/UFE sampler realizations may still differ between sessions
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.estimator_and_ci: Nadeau-Bengio corrected mean delta and two-sided 95% CI across the same 20 splits
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.h3_metaifd_plus: not a confirmatory hypothesis in v2.1.1; comparisons with Meta-IFD+ may be reported as explicitly exploratory/descriptive
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.margin_rationale: fixed before v2.1/v2.1.1 execution; a rounded conservative margin slightly above the upper Meta-IFD seed-to-seed variation observed in v1 (about 0.3–0.8 percentage points) and materially smaller than the UFE gains observed for the weaker baselines
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.multiplicity: Holm correction within H2a/H2b, reported for both non-inferiority and gated superiority
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.noninferiority_rule: lower bound of the two-sided NB 95% CI > -0.01 and Holm-adjusted one-sided non-inferiority p < 0.025
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.question: Are the simpler RF+ and LightGBM+ models non-inferior to the reproduced original Meta-IFD baseline, and if so are they superior?
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.superiority_gate: evaluated only after non-inferiority passes; lower bound of the same NB 95% CI > 0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided superiority p < 0.025; alpha is not split
h2_cross_model_confirmatory.unit_of_analysis: paired split-level delta after averaging five model seeds for each model

matching_rule: Within each pair and split, baseline and plus share the fixed configuration, train/validation/test node IDs, model seed, threshold, and materialized sampled batches/views. Plus differs only by receiving the 12-dimensional label-free UFE input/branch.
patch_note: v2.1.1 restores the flat Meta-IFD CONFIG aliases required by the unchanged audited training code; no hypothesis, split, seed, model, feature, threshold, or inference rule changed

planning_sensitivity_disclosure.basis: approximate planning calculations made from fully observed v1 effects/variability; not inferential results and not guarantees
planning_sensitivity_disclosure.interpretation: v2.1.1 is informative even if Meta-IFD H1 or H2 superiority does not pass; all outcomes will be reported
planning_sensitivity_disclosure.metaifd_plus_vs_metaifd_h1: for v1 delta about +0.85 percentage points, k=20 has approximate marginal power 0.63 under the NB variance assumption before global Holm; if Meta-IFD remains the largest p-value while the other five are much smaller as in v1, its Holm multiplier is one, otherwise effective power is lower
planning_sensitivity_disclosure.rf_plus_vs_metaifd_h2: v1 suggested delta about +0.96 percentage points; approximate marginal non-inferiority power is about 0.9, while superiority power is below 0.5 (about 0.4); these are planning estimates before seeing v2.1.1

primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the six primary model-pair p-values
primary_inference.success_rule: mean delta >= 0.005, Nadeau-Bengio 95% CI lower bound > 0, and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
primary_inference.test: two-sided Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t-test on 20 split-level paired deltas

primary_metric: test Macro-F1 at a fixed threshold of 0.5

prior_evidence_disclosure.interpretation: v2.1.1 is not an extension stopped when significance is reached; all 20 new splits and all six pairs must be run and reported regardless of outcome

limitations: random re-splits reuse the same 2763 labeled nodes
not an external, temporal, or unseen-dataset holdout
PyG neighborhood sampling may differ across sessions, but variants within each pair reuse identical materialized inputs
reporting_commitment.paper_comparison: Use the already completed author/paper split as Table A. V2.1.1 is Table B replication and is not a direct numerical comparison with the paper table.

resampling.method: 20 predetermined stratified random 60/20/20 splits over the same 2763 labeled EOA
resampling.seed_choice_rationale: a fixed transparent sequence of 20 new seeds, disjoint from v1, chosen before v2.1.1 execution; 20 is a computational-budget choice to estimate split variability more stably, not a data-dependent stopping point

research_question: Does adding the same 12 label-free UFE features improve each matched baseline across split variability?
scientific_role: fixed-budget, outcome-independent replication of the six matched comparisons

selection_and_blinding.configurations: frozen from v1 validation decisions / official Meta-IFD default
selection_and_blinding.test_materialization: after validation decisions/checkpoints are frozen within each split

status: FROZEN AFTER ALL V1 RESULTS; V2.1 SETUP BUG OBSERVED; BEFORE ANY V2.1.1 EXPERIMENTAL RESULT

ufe.definition: rows/count/sum x in/out x call/trans inside each sampled batch

unit_of_analysis: for each split: mean Macro-F1 over five model seeds; paired delta = plus minus baseline
